title: Helping another team – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Helping another team
hero.lead: Under Helping another team, you specify whether a player may generally be considered as additional support for other suitable teams. This setting is not a commitment to a particular match.

body:
Save availability

  1. Open Matches and select the Helping another team tab.
  2. If several player profiles are linked to your account, first select the relevant profile.
  3. Enable Available to help another team if coaches may find the player in a suitable pool of available players. Disable it if the player should not be considered.
  4. If necessary, enter useful details under Note for coaches, such as suitable positions or time restrictions.
  5. Select Save. A success message confirms that the change has been applied.

When a coach can see the player

Enabling the switch alone is not sufficient. Kaderblick also applies the configured age-group and competition rules. The player appears in a coach’s pool only when the player profile matches those rules.

Three ways to help out

  1. Select an age-eligible player: In a match wizard, the coach opens Additional players and selects All eligible players. This includes matching players without general availability and sends an invitation for that match.
  2. Declare general availability: A player or linked account enables Available to help out. If age and competition rules match, the player appears among available candidates.
  3. Offer help for a visible match: An eligible player can offer help for a matching future match; the responsible coach decides.

Invitations, offers and notifications

  • Additional players are planned while creating or editing the match.
  • A new offer notifies coaches of the participating teams and the match creator.
  • Acceptance gives the player access to the event and records an accepted attendance response.
  • Acceptance or rejection notifies the player and links to the event.
  • Pending and accepted offers remain visible in My Matchday; rejected or not-needed offers disappear from that selection.

If saving is not available

If no player profile is linked, Kaderblick displays a warning. The availability switch and Save button remain disabled until the account is linked to a player. An authorised club or team administrator creates this link under user relations.

Differences by role and relation

  • Players with a linked account: manage their own availability.
  • Parents and other player relations: manage availability for the linked players offered to them. A selector appears when several profiles are available.
  • Coaches who also have a player profile: can manage their personal availability as a player. Without a player profile, the warning state is shown and saving is unavailable.
  • Coaches acting as coaches: see suitable available players in the relevant match workflow; they do not change a player’s personal availability.
  • Supporters and administration-only roles: have no availability setting to save unless they also have a player relation.

Related areas

  • Player profiles and relations are managed under Players and in the administration area.
  • Specific invitations and responses appear under My matchday.
  • Authorised administrators manage the age-group and competition rules.
